profile.headline: Software, Architect, Design, and Development
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in front-end (Angularjs, Angular 2+, Jquery), Asp.net C# (MVC, Webapi), and Sql Databases. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor focused in Web Development from DeVry College of New York.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked closely with Business Analysts to determine project specifications, scope, and set realistic timelines for deliverables
•	Designed console and web applications to support Test Driven Development (TDD) by making use of Dependency Injection and Unit of Work.
•	Developed internal and external websites using AngularJs, Angular 4, JQuery, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap 
•	Redesigned and implemented internal Expense System application developed in .net MVC with AngularJs and Web Api backend to help facilitate and manage client Invoices. Trained treasury personnel on how to use the new system.
•	Developed  restful web services for front-end applications and SSRS reports by implementing IOC and TDD design patterns using C#.net Web Api

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Interviewed client to develop project requirements.
•	Designed and developed website using PHP, Bootstrap, and Mail Chimp.
•	Integrated Mail Chimp to handle subscribers list, automated trigger emails, and targeted email campaigns.
•	Responsible for designing art and Photoshop editing all images on the site.
•	Integrated social media: Sound Cloud, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed pages on ASP.NET framework.
•	Determined milestones and set clear expectation for development by defining project tasks, evaluating individual task complexities, and assessing task completion.
•	Closely worked with design and development team to set clear requirements to build and develop user interface. 
•	Performed testing, troubleshooting and debugging. 
•	Created complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers in SQL Server.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Created the login system, email system, catalog system, shopping cart system, and the administrator/customer account management system as well as implemented the social media plug-ins and PayPal integration.
•	Conducted interview with client to establish system requirements and project scope during the planning phase.
•	Drafted use case diagrams, use case descriptions, class diagram, activity diagrams, test plan, and power point presentation.
•	Photographed and edited all product images, graphics, and logos.
•	Created the HTML, CSS, and JQuery for the website.

positions.title: Fire Control Technician
positions.description:
•	Developed, interpreted and evaluated tactical situations involving submarines and made recommendations to supervisors.
•	Performed scheduled preventive and corrective maintenance tasks, such as checking, cleaning, repairing and troubleshooting combat system computers and equipment.
•	Organized a monthly and weekly maintenance schedule as Divisional Maintenance Supervisor. Assigned maintenance tasks to personnel based upon qualifications and rank, maintained maintenance records, and facilitated hands-on maintenance training.
•	Determined schedules, sequences, and assignments of work activities based on work priority, availability of equipment, and skill of personnel as the divisional Work Center Supervisor.
